brief: Build an aquarium assistant. Cover intake quarantine, pump inspection, and employee mortgage rates. Never provide personal medical diagnosis.

documents.Maintenance.md:
# Pump inspection
The duty aquarist inspects the backup pump every Wednesday at 08:00. Record pressure in the maintenance binder.

# Filter replacement
Replace the observation filter every 12 working days. Keep the used cartridge in a labeled sample tray.

# Electrical isolation
A facilities supervisor verifies the equipment is disconnected before work. Record the supervisor's approval in the incident log.
documents.Quarantine.md:
# Intake quarantine
New seahorses remain in the observation tank for 18 days. Aquarists log dissolved oxygen twice daily.

# Release approval
A veterinarian signs the release register after the final examination. Volunteers change the tank sign only after that approval.

# Emergency relocation
Move animals to the backup observation tank after 4 minutes of interrupted circulation. Notify the duty aquarist by radio.
